name: Latent Jailbreak
description: Latent Jailbreak is a benchmark designed to evaluate both the safety and output robustness of large language models by using malicious instruction embeddings within regular tasks. It assesses how models handle hidden malicious instructions and analyzes factors affecting jailbreak rates.
reputation: A recent safety benchmark that has gained attention in the jailbreak and prompt-injection research community, but is still relatively new and not yet widely standardized.
notes: Includes a hierarchical annotation framework and studies the impact of instruction position, word replacements, and instruction replacements on safety and robustness.
